conversion_note: Only RUN_SUMMARY.json is converted using gzip.compress(original_bytes, mtime=0) with the default compression level. Its source hash/size describe the exact decompressed JSON bytes. Existing candidate-task.json.gz files are copied unchanged.
excluded: workspace, core-private, raw downloaded dataset files, ground-truth, credentials, and all other paths not explicitly allowlisted
scope: Original ITBench-AA R2 public evidence only; the separate transport continuation is excluded.
